title: Quantum Computers Explained – Limits of Human Technology
speaker: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
zh: 【Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell】量子電腦解釋—人類技術的侷限性（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Quantum Computers Explained – Limits of Human Technology For most of our history, human technology consisted of our brains, fire, and sharp sticks.
cues.en: Quantum Computers Explained – Limits of Human Technology For most of our history, human technology consisted of our brains, fire, and sharp sticks.
cues.zh: 從我們的歷史來看 人類的科技大都建立在腦、火與尖銳的棒子上

cues.text: While fire and sharp sticks became power plants and nuclear weapons,
cues.en: While fire and sharp sticks became power plants and nuclear weapons,
cues.zh: 人類的科技大都建立在腦、火與尖銳的棒子上 當火和尖銳棒狀物變成發電廠和核武時

cues.text: the biggest upgrade has happened to our brains.
cues.en: the biggest upgrade has happened to our brains.
cues.zh: 當火和尖銳棒狀物變成發電廠和核武時 腦的大進化已經開始發生 自從 1960 年來，電腦的運算能力呈獻指數性的成長

cues.text: Since the 1960's, the power of our brain machines has kept growing exponentially,
cues.en: Since the 1960's, the power of our brain machines has kept growing exponentially,
cues.zh: 自從 1960 年來，電腦的運算能力呈獻指數性的成長

cues.text: allowing computers to get smaller and more powerful at the same time.
cues.en: allowing computers to get smaller and more powerful at the same time.
cues.zh: 自從 1960 年來，電腦的運算能力呈獻指數性的成長 使得電腦愈來愈小，同時愈來愈強大

cues.text: But this process is about to meet its physical limits.
cues.en: But this process is about to meet its physical limits.
cues.zh: 但是演化已經快碰到了物理上的極限

cues.text: Computer parts are approaching the size of an atom.
cues.en: Computer parts are approaching the size of an atom.
cues.zh: 但是演化已經快碰到了物理上的極限 電腦元件尺寸正在趨近於原子的大小

cues.text: To understand why this is a problem, we have to clear up some basics.
cues.en: To understand why this is a problem, we have to clear up some basics.
cues.zh: 為了說明這為什麼是個問題 我們必須要先講解一些基本知識

cues.text: In a Nutshell - By Kurzgesagt A computer is made up of very simple components
cues.en: In a Nutshell - By Kurzgesagt A computer is made up of very simple components
cues.zh: 電腦是由執行簡單功能的簡單元件所組合而成

cues.text: doing very simple things.
cues.en: doing very simple things.
cues.zh: 電腦是由執行簡單功能的簡單元件所組合而成 以呈獻資料、提供處理的方式、與控制機制

cues.text: Representing data, the means of processing it, and control mechanisms.
cues.en: Representing data, the means of processing it, and control mechanisms.
cues.zh: 以呈獻資料、提供處理的方式、與控制機制

cues.text: Computer chips contain modules, which contain logic gates, which contain transistors.
cues.en: Computer chips contain modules, which contain logic gates, which contain transistors.
cues.zh: 晶片包含模組，模組包含邏輯閘，邏輯閘包含電晶體 電晶體代表著電腦的處理器裡一個最簡單的型態

cues.text: A transistor is the simplest form of a data processor in computers,
cues.en: A transistor is the simplest form of a data processor in computers,
cues.zh: 電晶體代表著電腦的處理器裡一個最簡單的型態

cues.text: basically a switch that can either block, or open the way for information coming through.
cues.en: basically a switch that can either block, or open the way for information coming through.
cues.zh: 電晶體代表著電腦的處理器裡一個最簡單的型態 簡單說是個可以阻擋、透過資訊的開關

cues.text: This information is made up of bits which can be set to either 0 or 1.
cues.en: This information is made up of bits which can be set to either 0 or 1.
cues.zh: 簡單說是個可以阻擋、透過資訊的開關 而此資訊是由位元構成，它可以設為 0 或者 1

cues.text: Combinations of several bits are used to represent more complex information.
cues.en: Combinations of several bits are used to represent more complex information.
cues.zh: 而此資訊是由位元構成，它可以設為 0 或者 1 多個位元的組合通常代表著更複雜的資訊

cues.text: Transistors are combined to create logic gates which still do very simple stuff.
cues.en: Transistors are combined to create logic gates which still do very simple stuff.
cues.zh: 多個位元的組合通常代表著更複雜的資訊 將電晶體組合後會變成邏輯閘，它還是隻有簡單的功能

cues.text: For example, an AND Gate sends an output of 1 if all of its inputs are 1, and a output of 0 otherwise.
cues.en: For example, an AND Gate sends an output of 1 if all of its inputs are 1, and a output of 0 otherwise.
cues.zh: 將電晶體組合後會變成邏輯閘，它還是隻有簡單的功能 例如，一個 AND 閘只有在輸入值皆為 1 時才會輸出 1 否則就會輸出 0

cues.text: Combinations of logic gates finally form meaningful modules, say, for adding two numbers.
cues.en: Combinations of logic gates finally form meaningful modules, say, for adding two numbers.
cues.zh: 最終組合不同的邏輯閘形成了有意義的模組 比方說加法的功能模組

cues.text: Once you can add, you can also multiply, and once you can multiply, you can basically do anything.
cues.en: Once you can add, you can also multiply, and once you can multiply, you can basically do anything.
cues.zh: 比方說加法的功能模組 一旦你能夠使用加法，你也可以使用乘法 一旦可以使用乘法，基本上什麼都可以做了

cues.text: Since all basic operations are literally simpler than first grade math,
cues.en: Since all basic operations are literally simpler than first grade math,
cues.zh: 自從所有基本運算都比一年級的數學簡單

cues.text: you can imagine a computer as a group of 7-year-olds answering really basic math questions.
cues.en: you can imagine a computer as a group of 7-year-olds answering really basic math questions.
cues.zh: 自從所有基本運算都比一年級的數學簡單 你可將電腦想像為一群在回答基礎數學題的 7 歲小孩

cues.text: A large enough bunch of them could compute anything from astrophysics to Zelda.
cues.en: A large enough bunch of them could compute anything from astrophysics to Zelda.
cues.zh: 你可將電腦想像為一群在回答基礎數學題的 7 歲小孩 足夠數量的小孩可以計算所有的東西 不論是天文物理或薩爾達傳說

cues.text: However, with parts getting tinier and tinier, quantum physics are making things tricky.
cues.en: However, with parts getting tinier and tinier, quantum physics are making things tricky.
cues.zh: 然而隨著元件愈變愈小，量子力學讓事情變得很詭異

cues.text: In a nutshell, a transistor is just an electric switch.
cues.en: In a nutshell, a transistor is just an electric switch.
cues.zh: 簡而言之，一個電晶體只是一個電流開關

cues.text: Electricity is electrons moving from one place to another.
cues.en: Electricity is electrons moving from one place to another.
cues.zh: 電流表示電子由一端流向另一端

cues.text: So, a switch is a passage that can block electrons from moving in one direction.
cues.en: So, a switch is a passage that can block electrons from moving in one direction.
cues.zh: 電流表示電子由一端流向另一端 所以開關就是可決定是否讓電子流過的單向通道

cues.text: Today, a typical scale for transistors is 14 nanometers,
cues.en: Today, a typical scale for transistors is 14 nanometers,
cues.zh: 現今的電晶體尺寸大約是 14 奈米

cues.text: which is about 8 times less than the HIV virus' diameter, and 500 times smaller than a red blood cell.
cues.en: which is about 8 times less than the HIV virus' diameter, and 500 times smaller than a red blood cell.
cues.zh: 是 HIV 病毒直徑的 1/8 倍 然後是紅血球的 1/500 倍

cues.text: As transistors are shrinking to the size of only a few atoms,
cues.en: As transistors are shrinking to the size of only a few atoms,
cues.zh: 然後是紅血球的 1/500 倍 當電晶體小到僅幾顆原子大的尺寸時

cues.text: electrons may just transfer themselves to the other side of a blocked passage
cues.en: electrons may just transfer themselves to the other side of a blocked passage
cues.zh: 當電晶體小到僅幾顆原子大的尺寸時 電子會無視阻擋將自己傳送到另一端

cues.text: via a process called Quantum Tunneling.
cues.en: via a process called Quantum Tunneling.
cues.zh: 電子會無視阻擋將自己傳送到另一端 這現象稱作量子穿隧效應

cues.text: In the quantum realm, physics works quite differently from the predictable ways we're used to,
cues.en: In the quantum realm, physics works quite differently from the predictable ways we're used to,
cues.zh: 在量子世界裡 物理運作方式和我們平常看到的不太一樣

cues.text: and traditional computers just stop making sense.
cues.en: and traditional computers just stop making sense.
cues.zh: 物理運作方式和我們平常看到的不太一樣 而傳統的電腦就開始沒邏輯了

cues.text: We are approaching a real physical barrier for our technological progress.
cues.en: We are approaching a real physical barrier for our technological progress.
cues.zh: 我們的科技正一步步接近物理的極限

cues.text: To solve this problem, scientists are trying to use these unusual quantum properties to their advantage
cues.en: To solve this problem, scientists are trying to use these unusual quantum properties to their advantage
cues.zh: 我們的科技正一步步接近物理的極限 為瞭解決這問題 科學家嘗試利用量子物理不尋常的特性中的優點

cues.text: by building quantum computers.
cues.en: by building quantum computers.
cues.zh: 科學家嘗試利用量子物理不尋常的特性中的優點 方法就是製造臺量子電腦

cues.text: In normal computers, bits are the smallest unit of information.
cues.en: In normal computers, bits are the smallest unit of information.
cues.zh: 方法就是製造臺量子電腦 在一般電腦中，位元代表著資訊的最小單位

cues.text: Quantum computers use qubits which can also be set to one of two values.
cues.en: Quantum computers use qubits which can also be set to one of two values.
cues.zh: 量子電腦使用的是量子位元 他同樣可以設成 0 和 1

cues.text: A qubit can be any two level quantum system, such as a spin and a magnetic field, or a single photon.
cues.en: A qubit can be any two level quantum system, such as a spin and a magnetic field, or a single photon.
cues.zh: 一個量子位元可以是任何二階的量子系統 像是自旋和磁場，或是單一的光子

cues.text: 0 and 1 are this system's possible states, like the photons horizontal or vertical polarization.
cues.en: 0 and 1 are this system's possible states, like the photons horizontal or vertical polarization.
cues.zh: 0 和 1 是系統中可能存在的狀態 就像是光子橫向或縱向的偏振

cues.text: In the quantum world, the qubit doesn't have to be just one of those,
cues.en: In the quantum world, the qubit doesn't have to be just one of those,
cues.zh: 在量子世界裡，量子位元不一定是這兩種狀態之一

cues.text: it can be in any proportions of both states at once.
cues.en: it can be in any proportions of both states at once.
cues.zh: 在量子世界裡，量子位元不一定是這兩種狀態之一 他可以在他們間同時表現出所有的偏振狀態

cues.text: This is called superposition.
cues.en: This is called superposition.
cues.zh: 這被稱作為量子疊加

cues.text: But as soon as you test its value, say, by sending the photon through a filter,
cues.en: But as soon as you test its value, say, by sending the photon through a filter,
cues.zh: 這被稱作為量子疊加 但當你想把一個光子送到濾波器做測試時

cues.text: it has to decide to be either vertically or horizontally polarized.
cues.en: it has to decide to be either vertically or horizontally polarized.
cues.zh: 它必須決定自己是縱向或橫向偏振

cues.text: So as long as it's unobserved, the qubit is in a superposition of probabilities for 0 and 1, and you can't predit which it'll be.
cues.en: So as long as it's unobserved, the qubit is in a superposition of probabilities for 0 and 1, and you can't predit which it'll be.
cues.zh: 所以當它被觀測之前 量子位元就代表著 1 和 0 間所有可能的疊加狀態 你無法預期是哪個狀態

cues.text: But the instant you measure it, it collapses into one of the definite states.
cues.en: But the instant you measure it, it collapses into one of the definite states.
cues.zh: 但當你測量它的瞬間，它將會塌陷為一個固定的狀態

cues.text: Superposition is a game changer.
cues.en: Superposition is a game changer.
cues.zh: 量子疊加狀態改變了遊戲的規則

cues.text: Four classical bits can be in one of two to the power of four different configurations at a time.
cues.en: Four classical bits can be in one of two to the power of four different configurations at a time.
cues.zh: 量子疊加狀態改變了遊戲的規則 四個傳統位元中，每個位元各自表示兩種狀態中的一種

cues.text: That's 16 possible combinations, out of which you can use just one.
cues.en: That's 16 possible combinations, out of which you can use just one.
cues.zh: 這共包含了 16 種不同的組合，但只能使用其的一組

cues.text: Four qubits in superposition, however, can be in all of those 16 combinations at once.
cues.en: Four qubits in superposition, however, can be in all of those 16 combinations at once.
cues.zh: 四個量子位元則可以同時代表著 16 種狀態

cues.text: This number grows exponentially with each extra qubit.
cues.en: This number grows exponentially with each extra qubit.
cues.zh: 四個量子位元則可以同時代表著 16 種狀態 每增加額外的量子位元，組合數將會是指數性的成長

cues.text: Twenty of them can already store a million values in parallel.
cues.en: Twenty of them can already store a million values in parallel.
cues.zh: 20 個量子位元就可以平行儲存 100 萬個數值

cues.text: A really weird and unintuitive property qubits can have is Entanglement,
cues.en: A really weird and unintuitive property qubits can have is Entanglement,
cues.zh: 量子位元還有一個詭異並不確定性的特性 那就是量子糾纏

cues.text: a close connection that makes each of the qubits react to a change in the other's state instantaneously,
cues.en: a close connection that makes each of the qubits react to a change in the other's state instantaneously,
cues.zh: 那就是量子糾纏 他使另一組糾纏狀態的量子位元呈獻與自己相反的狀態

cues.text: no matter how far they are apart.
cues.en: no matter how far they are apart.
cues.zh: 他使另一組糾纏狀態的量子位元呈獻與自己相反的狀態 就算他們之間被分開多遠都一樣

cues.text: This means when measuring just one entangled qubit, you can directly deduce properties of it's partners
cues.en: This means when measuring just one entangled qubit, you can directly deduce properties of it's partners
cues.zh: 就算他們之間被分開多遠都一樣 這意味著只要測量其中一個糾纏態的量子位元 利用這特性就能不用觀測而得知另一組結果

cues.text: without having to look.
cues.en: without having to look.
cues.zh: 利用這特性就能不用觀測而得知另一組結果

cues.text: Qubit Manipulation is a mind bender as well.
cues.en: Qubit Manipulation is a mind bender as well.
cues.zh: 操控量子位元就像是腦筋急轉彎

cues.text: A normal logic gate gets a simple set of inputs and produces one definite output.
cues.en: A normal logic gate gets a simple set of inputs and produces one definite output.
cues.zh: 一個普通的邏輯閘有著單純的輸入， 並產生一個固定的輸出

cues.text: A quantum gate manipulates an input of superpositions, rotates probabilities,
cues.en: A quantum gate manipulates an input of superpositions, rotates probabilities,
cues.zh: 量子閘輸入一個疊加 旋轉他改變機率，輸出另一個疊加

cues.text: and produces another superposition as its output.
cues.en: and produces another superposition as its output.
cues.zh: 旋轉他改變機率，輸出另一個疊加

cues.text: So a quantum computer sets up some qubits, applies quantum gates to entangle them and manipulate probabilities,
cues.en: So a quantum computer sets up some qubits, applies quantum gates to entangle them and manipulate probabilities,
cues.zh: 所以一臺量子電腦操作部份的量子閘產生糾纏 並控制機率，最後測量輸出

cues.text: then finally measures the outcome, collapsing superpositions to an actual sequence of 0s and 1s.
cues.en: then finally measures the outcome, collapsing superpositions to an actual sequence of 0s and 1s.
cues.zh: 並控制機率，最後測量輸出 讓疊加狀態崩潰後得出最後結果的 0 和 1

cues.text: What this means is that you get the entire lot of calculations that are possible with your setup, all done at the same time.
cues.en: What this means is that you get the entire lot of calculations that are possible with your setup, all done at the same time.
cues.zh: 讓疊加狀態崩潰後得出最後結果的 0 和 1 這意味著你可以將這麼多種可能性同時進行運算

cues.text: Ultimately, you can only measure one of the results and it'll only probably be the one you want,
cues.en: Ultimately, you can only measure one of the results and it'll only probably be the one you want,
cues.zh: 這意味著你可以將這麼多種可能性同時進行運算 最終你只會測量到一個結果 而這結果只是有很高的機率可能就是你要的

cues.text: so you may have to double check and try again.
cues.en: so you may have to double check and try again.
cues.zh: 而這結果只是有很高的機率可能就是你要的 所以你可能要多計算幾次以檢查結果

cues.text: But by cleverly exploiting superposition and entanglement, this can be exponentially more efficient than would ever be possible on a normal computer.
cues.en: But by cleverly exploiting superposition and entanglement, this can be exponentially more efficient than would ever be possible on a normal computer.
cues.zh: 但巧妙地運用疊加和量子糾纏 效率相比一般電腦將會是指數性的成長

cues.text: So, while quantum computers will not probably not replace our home computers,
cues.en: So, while quantum computers will not probably not replace our home computers,
cues.zh: 所以量子電腦雖然無法取代現在的電腦

cues.text: in some areas, they are vastly superior.
cues.en: in some areas, they are vastly superior.
cues.zh: 在某些領域他們是非常優越的

cues.text: One of them is database searching.
cues.en: One of them is database searching.
cues.zh: 其中之一就是資料庫搜尋

cues.text: To find something in a database, a normal computer may have to test every single one of its entries.
cues.en: To find something in a database, a normal computer may have to test every single one of its entries.
cues.zh: 一般電腦再資料庫中搜尋可能要搜尋每一份資料

cues.text: Quantum computers algorithms need only the square root of that time, which for large databases, is a huge difference
cues.en: Quantum computers algorithms need only the square root of that time, which for large databases, is a huge difference
cues.zh: 量子演演算法只需要原來運算時間開根號的時間 這在大型資料庫上會有著極大的差距

cues.text: The most famous use of quantum computers is ruining IT security.
cues.en: The most famous use of quantum computers is ruining IT security.
cues.zh: 量子電腦中最著名的用法就是破解資訊安全機制

cues.text: Right now, your browsing, email, and banking data is being kept secure by an encryption system
cues.en: Right now, your browsing, email, and banking data is being kept secure by an encryption system
cues.zh: 量子電腦中最著名的用法就是破解資訊安全機制 現在你瀏覽的銀行郵件還是被加密系統給保護著

cues.text: in which you give everyone a public key to encode messages only you can decode.
cues.en: in which you give everyone a public key to encode messages only you can decode.
cues.zh: 現在你瀏覽的銀行郵件還是被加密系統給保護著 藉由你給其它使用者不同組的公鑰 ，來加密只有你能解密的訊息

cues.text: The problem is that this public key can actually be used to calculate your secret private key.
cues.en: The problem is that this public key can actually be used to calculate your secret private key.
cues.zh: ，來加密只有你能解密的訊息 問題是拿到公鑰的人可以計算出你的金鑰

cues.text: Luckily, doing the necessary math on any normal computer would literally take years of trial and error.
cues.en: Luckily, doing the necessary math on any normal computer would literally take years of trial and error.
cues.zh: 幸運的是使用一般的電腦必須花上數年運算， 不斷地嘗試錯誤才有辦法解開

cues.text: But a quantum computer with exponential speed-up could do it in a breeze.
cues.en: But a quantum computer with exponential speed-up could do it in a breeze.
cues.zh: 不斷地嘗試錯誤才有辦法解開 但對於量子電腦，由於運算速率是指數性的成長 可能只是小菜一碟

cues.text: Another really exciting new use is simulations.
cues.en: Another really exciting new use is simulations.
cues.zh: 另一個著名的用法就是當作模擬器

cues.text: Simulations of the quantum world are very intense on resources,
cues.en: Simulations of the quantum world are very intense on resources,
cues.zh: 模擬量子環境非常地吃資源

cues.text: and even for bigger structures, such as molecules, they often lack accuracy.
cues.en: and even for bigger structures, such as molecules, they often lack accuracy.
cues.zh: 更或者一些巨大的結構體，例如分子結構 他們通常缺乏精準度

cues.text: So why not simulate quantum physics with actual quantum physics?
cues.en: So why not simulate quantum physics with actual quantum physics?
cues.zh: 他們通常缺乏精準度 所以為何不用真實的量子電腦來模擬量子物理環境呢？

cues.text: Quantum simulations could provide new insights on proteins that might revolutionize medicine.
cues.en: Quantum simulations could provide new insights on proteins that might revolutionize medicine.
